title: CRLR/6/2014 of Smt Sanjiwani Rathore Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND THROUGH SECRETARY HOME,DEHRADUN

Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
None appears for the revisionist.
Mr. V.S. Rathore, AGA for the State.
The instant revision has yet not been
admitted. It was filed in the 2014. On
10.03.2014, notices were issued on delay
condonation application.
The last report of the Registry records
that service report has not been received.
Today, the revisionist is absent.
A criminal revision once admitted
cannot be dismissed in non-prosecution. But,
the instant revision has yet not been admitted.
The revisionist is absent.
Therefore, the delay condonation
application stands dismissed and consequent to
it, the instant criminal revision is also
dismissed.
